'''Safe Home''' was the name given to an uncharted [[Planet/Legends|planet]] by a group of independent [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] who discovered it during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The scouts, members of the old [[Republic Scout Service/Legends|Scout Service]], kept the existence of the planet secret and retired on this world to escape the horrors of war. They were supplied by a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who had managed to convince them that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had been defeated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[June]] [[2015]] that Safe Home was excluded from [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] because it was a military code name.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2015-06-30}}</ref>
